title: Case sidecar manifest v1
description: The evidgate.cases.yaml file that sits next to the test files it describes (03.1.1, TL T55): it maps each test file of its own directory to the durable evidgate.id of the case it holds. The YAML is converted to JSON and validated against this schema; semantic checks (the file exists in the tree, no duplicate file entry, no second source) are the reader's. The file is parsed as plain data: anchors, tags and merge keys are refused before this point.

file.description: Path relative to the manifest's own directory, forward slashes, no leading slash, no '..' segment.

requirement.description: Optional external requirement this file protects (D-A6): trimmed to 1..128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : / # -. A string is used as written and a number as its digits; a bare true/false is a warning on this entry and the case keeps a null reference. A string or number outside the length or charset rule fails this schema, so the manifest is refused as invalid.
